summary: Testbenches shipped: every evidence directory under verification/records/ and every measured target-spec row is mapped to its committed bench and cold-start command, with the klt pin, cocotb pin, PDK revision (IHP-Open-PDK 2bbec755) and formal toolchain pin; rows with no measurement say so. Audited 2026-10-10 at klt v0.7.0, issue #83. Refreshed for issue #137 (the load-integrity bench). Refreshed for issue #141 (the row-13 WS2812 bench). Refreshed for issue #235 (the row-13 stretch PS/2 bench). Refreshed for issue #211 (the count-alias bench now asserts rejection; the gate-level netlist of gds run 38108543866). Refreshed for issues #244 and #246 (the gate-level lines name the netlist of gds run 38136727636; the control-space bench has the open-drain pad-data test; the SDF line names the protocol suite). Refreshed for issue #258 (the I2C ACK-schedule bench and its mutant runner on the firmware-i2c line). Refreshed for issue #259 (the i2c-ack-window formal experiment: ACK-window property, runner and records). Refreshed for issue #350 (the librelane-erc experiment: klt erc supply spec on the LibreLane GDS). Refreshed for issue #356 (the klt pin moves to the PyPI release klayout-tools==0.8.0; the inventory comment naming the pin is updated, nothing else).
